title: In an hour, a week ago, for two days

blocks.text: The preposition на + acc. is used to indicate the length of time one expects to stay some place, or the time something is expected to last: *Он приехал сюда на два дня. Я получил отпуск на неделю.* Note also: на следующий день — next day.

The preposition за + acc. denotes the time that it takes to accomplish an action: *Он сделает это за неделю. Я прочитал эту книгу за два дня.* «за + acc.» is also used in combination with «до + gen.» to denote the time of one event taking place before some other event: *Он умер за год до войны.*
From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 73, 77.
Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: I'll be back in a month.
exercises.why: «The preposition через means „across, over, through“. In time expressions it means „in“, „after“. This preposition is used with the accusative case: Я буду там через неделю.» And with после: «„через“ + Acc. in combination with „после“ + Gen. denotes the time of one event taking place after some other event.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 47 (p. 137) and 77.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: ЧЕРЕЗ + Accusative: in time expressions it means “in”, “after”. (DLI, Lessons 47 (p. 137) and 77)

exercises.prompt: He left here two or three days ago.
exercises.why: «In expressions answering the questions „How long?“ and „How long ago?“ the accusative case is used: Я был там год. — Я был там год тому назад.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 41. «2, 3, 4 + Gen. sing.; 5 and up + Gen. plur.»: «After три and четыре… the noun is also in the genitive singular… After all other numerals (пять, шесть, семь, etc.)… the noun is in the genitive plural.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 39.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: “How long ago?” — the accusative, followed by (тому) назад. (DLI, Lesson 41)

exercises.prompt: Will you put us up for one night?
exercises.why: «The preposition НА + Acc. is used: (a) to indicate the length of time one expects to stay some place, or the time something is expected to last; (b) after the verb опаздывать / опоздать to indicate the amount of time by which someone is late.» «Note also such expressions as: на следующий день — (next day).» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 73.
exercises.context: НА + Accusative indicates how long something is expected to last. (DLI, Lesson 73)

exercises.q: За ___ (неделя) он постарел на несколько лет.
exercises.prompt: He aged several years in the course of a week.
exercises.why: «The preposition ЗА + Acc. denotes the time that it takes to accomplish an action.» «„ЗА + Acc.“ is also used in combination with „ДО + Gen.“ to denote the time of one event taking place before some other event: Он умер за год до войны.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 77.
exercises.context: ЗА + Accusative denotes the time that it takes to accomplish an action. (DLI, Lesson 77)

exercises.q: Этот запах навеял воспоминания об одной ночи несколько ___ (годы) назад.
exercises.prompt: The smell brought back memories of a night some years before.
exercises.why: «For the genitive plural of the noun год the word лет is used: один год, два года, пять лет.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 41. «2, 3, 4 + Gen. sing.; 5 and up + Gen. plur.»: «After три and четыре… the noun is also in the genitive singular… After all other numerals (пять, шесть, семь, etc.)… the noun is in the genitive plural.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 39.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: For the genitive plural of год the word лет is used. (DLI, Lesson 41)
